        set interfaces ethernet {{ vlan_raw_device }} vif 20 address 10.10.20.1/24

  hosts: alpine
  gather_facts: no
  tasks:
    - name: Install python3 if missing
      ansible.builtin.raw: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || apk add --no-cache python3
      changed_when: false

- name: Put node2/node3 each on their own VLAN over the shared link and route via node1
  hosts: alpine
  gather_facts: yes
  become: yes
  vars:
    vlan_iface: "{{ vlan_raw_device }}.{{ vlan_id }}"
  tasks:
    - name: Load 8021q kernel module
      community.general.modprobe:
        name: 8021q
        state: present
        persistent: present

    - name: Bring up the shared trunk interface
      ansible.builtin.command: ip link set {{ vlan_raw_device }} up
      changed_when: true

    - name: Create the tagged VLAN sub-interface
      ansible.builtin.command: ip link add link {{ vlan_raw_device }} name {{ vlan_iface }} type vlan id {{ vlan_id }}
      args:
        creates: /sys/class/net/{{ vlan_iface }}

    - name: Assign the VLAN IP address
      ansible.builtin.command: ip addr replace {{ vlan_address }} dev {{ vlan_iface }}
      changed_when: true

    - name: Bring up the VLAN sub-interface
      ansible.builtin.command: ip link set {{ vlan_iface }} up
      changed_when: true

      ansible.builtin.command: ip route replace {{ peer_subnet }} via {{ gateway }} dev {{ vlan_iface }}
